div.div:
Required access
Deploy: Fabric Workspace Admin; capacity admin/contributor; SQL db_owner (or equivalent DDL/load rights); SharePoint Site Owner; Power Platform Environment Maker; Azure Contributor and role-assignment rights for Search/OpenAI.
Use: semantic model Build; published-agent access; SharePoint read; authorized Power Platform Search connection.
Optional RAG auth: Copilot uses an invoker connection backed by an admin key in the encrypted Power Platform connection store; Search managed identity uses Cognitive Services OpenAI User.
